tasks.label: Build (Visual Studio Build Tools)
tasks.command: cmake -S . -B build -A x64; cmake --build build --config Release; Copy-Item build/Release/BatteryTray.exe . -Force

tasks.label: Build (MSYS2 MinGW)
tasks.command: cmake -S . -B build-mingw -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; cmake --build build-mingw; Copy-Item build-mingw/BatteryTray.exe . -Force
